tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam can rdo rje legs pa'i bskul bzhugs lags so// dam can rdo rje legs pa'i/ dug mda' 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bzhi pa las/ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho badz+ra sa du sa ma yaḥ rdo rje 'bar ba has bya hus byaḥ gle gad kyai tshur spyon tshur byonaḥ badz+ra a 'gu sha dzaḥ spyan drangs shing 'dzab kyi bod pa'i sngags so/ /badz+ra sa du sa ma ya srog tri du ma ra ṇa dzāḥ srog thug thug ma ra ṇa dzāḥ srog sbud sbud ma ra ṇa dzaḥ sha la du khrag tsha du ma la shog dza dzaḥ drag tu bzlas la bsgrub pa'i sngags so/ /de nas las la bskul bar bshad/ kyai dge bsnyen chen po mthu bo che/ /mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs las/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /seṅge rtsal can khams su zil gyis gnon/ /sku la dar nag khams gsum dbang du bsdud/ /g.yas kyi rdo rjes bdug pa rdul du rlog /g.yon pas dam nyams dgra bo'i tsi ta 'dzin/ /lcags spyang rgyug 'dur dgra bo'i bla 'khyims sgrol/ /btsan 'khor gsum brgya dgra la jag pa byed/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir dam rdzas 'di gsol la/ bdag gi bcol ba'i las rnam grub par mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /maṅga laṃ/ /sngags 'chang 'gro pa rnams kyi srung ma rnam gsum la gtor ma gtong ba'i lag len bsam don kun 'grub bzhugs// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ 'dir slob dpon chen po'i dam btags sngags 'chang 'gro pa rnams kyi srung ma dam can rdo rje legs pa dang / dpal lha mo yak+ṣa mo/ brag gi btsan rgod dmar po gsum la gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ phye gtsang ma la zlum gtor dkar po gsum la sha mar sogs dkar dmar gyis brgyan cing mdzes kyis brgyan pa'i mtha' skor du/ dkar gsum sogs zas sna gang 'dzoms dang / 'byor na mda' dar sna lnga la sogs pa mkho dgu'i longs spyod kyi yongs su gang bar byas nas/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis dran/ rang nyid stan la 'dug ste yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed sgom pa'am/

sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum de nas gong gi gtor ma sogs la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas ma dag pa bsang zhing / rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañja ra na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pas gzi byin bskyed la/ rin po che'i snod yangs pa bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsam nas/ rdo rje bsdam pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul du byas la/ oṃ a ka ra ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ/ ā d+ya a nud paṇa na twad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ ces brjod pas ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsam zhing / rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dpal lha mo yak+ṣa mo 'khor bcas/ bran btsan mthu bo che 'khor dang bcas pa sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dza/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas bsrung ma rnams 'khor bcas mngon sum du byon par bsam la/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥ sarba thād khaṃ/ urga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gh+ri h+ne daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes pas sngags bdun nam nyer gcig res so sor phul la/ yid kyi dmigs pa srung ma rnams mnyes par byed pa'i za btung gi tshogs du ma dang / gser dngul sogs rin po che'i rigs dang / ja gos dar/ sman 'bru bcud sogs dang / rta g.yag khyi/ lug sogs dang / seṅge/ dom/ dred/ stag gzig rma bya/ ne tso sogs srog chags kyi rigs du ma dang / mdor na mthun rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pas sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab par bskang nas srung ma so so la phul bas/ bzhes shing rol te tshim zhing dges nas rang la bu gcig pa'i ma ltar shin tu brtse gdung dang ldan par gyur par bsam nas/ yod na ting brdung shing / slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/

/spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'i/ /dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor bcas dang / /sngon tshe shākya seṅge'i spyan snga ru/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong bar dam bcas pa'i/ /dpal ldan yak+ṣa lha mo 'khor bcas dang / /mthu ldan btsan rgod gnyen po mnyes pa'i phyir/ /rin chen thod snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ /ka ra shing thog sha khrag gtor ma sogs/ /bza' ba'i dngos po bcud ldan ri ltar spungs/ /rgya ja chang dang khrag zhag mtsho ltar skyil/ /tsan+dan dkar dmar ga pur gur gum dang / /spos dkar sogs kyi dud sprin nam mkha' khyab/ /khrab rmog gzhib dang mda' mdung ral dri sogs/ /sra brtan rno ngar ldan pa'i go mtshon tshogs/ /gser dngul mu tig mu men byu ru dang / /ma rgad pad dkar la sogs rin chen dang / /gos dang dar zab bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / /rin chen bdun dang bum bzang dpag bsam shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang yid bzhin rin po che/ /seṅge stag gzig la sogs gcan gzan tshogs/ /rta glang khyi lug ri dwags mang po dang / /ne tso khu byug la sogs 'dabs chags tshogs/ /srog chags kun kyang rin chen brgyan gyis spras/ /mdor na srung ma 'khor bcas mnyes byed pa'i/ /mchod sprin khams gsum khyab par sprul pa 'di/ /dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor bcas dang / /dpal ldan yak+ṣa lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ /brag gi btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /kun kyang tshim zhing so sor dges gyur nas/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /bsrung skyobs bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhes brjod cing / de nas mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas/ sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod cing srung ma rnams thugs mnyes bzhin pa'i ngang nas rang gnas su byon par bsam/ bsod nams 'di yi thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /zhes sogs kyi dge ba bsngos la/ gtor ma rnams sa gtsang sar skyel ba'am yang na dus dus su mtheb kyu'i gsos nas chu gtsang gis 'dran te gong bzhin bsngo ba sogs long skabs dang bstun nas nyams su blang bas rung ba nyid do/

/ces pa 'di yang rang gi slob ma 'gro'i rigs su skyes pa'i shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chos rje bstan pa'i rdo rje'i kha 'don du sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mgyog par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis don grub bo/ /'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi bar chad zhi zhing bsam don 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig nges pa'i don du rang sems las gzhan pa'i/ /srung ma med phyir 'khu ldog mi srid kyang / /kun rdzob 'khrul ngor las 'bras mi bslu bar/ /rgyal bas gsungs phyir 'dir 'bad don ldan gyur/ /phyogs dus kun du bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal 'bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje legs pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba dang bcas te bsnyen sgrub bya ba'i tshul gyi lag len don gnyis lhun grub zhugs// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ 'dir bstan bsrung chen po rdo rje legs pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba dang bcas te bsnyen sgrub bya ba'i tshul gyi lag len la/ ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas su phye gtsang ma la zlum gtor dkar po dmar gyis brgyan cing mdzes kyis brgyan pa dang / de'i mtha' skor du zas sna gang 'dzoms/ mda' dar sna lnga sogs spyan gzigs gyi tshogs gang 'byor gyis yongs su gang bar bshams nas/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis 'dren/ rang nyid stan la 'dug te yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed sgom pa'am/ yang na thun mtshams kyi lha gang rung gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/ de nas gong gi gtor ma sogs la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas ma dag pa bsang zhing / rdo rje'i me'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañja ra na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod pas gzi byin bskyed la/ rin po che'i snod yangs pa bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsam nas/

rdo rje bsdam pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul du byas la/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ/ a d+ya a nud paṇa na twad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsam zhing / rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas pa sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dza/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas srung ma 'khor bcas mngon sum du byon par bsam la/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥ sarba thād khaṃ/ at+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gh+ri h+nen+de ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags bdun nam nyer gcig gi phul la/ de nas yid kyi dmigs pa srung ma 'khor bcas mnyes par byed pa'i bza' btung gi tshogs du ma dang / gser dngul sogs rin po che'i rigs dang / ja gos dar/ sman 'bru bcud sogs dang / rda g.yag khyi lug seṅge/ dom/ dred/ stag sogs gcan zan gyi rigs du ma dang / rma bya ne tso sogs 'dabs chags kyi rigs yid du 'ong ba mang po sogs/ mdor na mthun rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pas sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab par bskang nas srung ma 'khor bcas la phul bas/ bzhes shing rol te tshim zhing dges nas/ rang la bu gcig pu'i ma ltar shin du rtse gdung dang ldan par gyur par bsam nas/ dam can rdo rje legs pa'i rgyud dug mda' 'bar ba'i le'u bzhi pa nas 'byung ba'i bod sngags 'di bzhin bzla bar bya ste/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho badz+ra sa du sa ma yaḥ rdo rje 'bar ba has bya hus bya/ gle gnad kyai tshur spyon tshun byonaḥ badz+ra a 'gu sha dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs shing bod pa'i sngags 'di brgya stong la sogs pa ji tsam nus pa bzlas la/ de nas rnga sogs rol mo brdung 'khrol dang bcas/ sngon tshe ston pa'i spyan sngar sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal zhes dam bcas shing /

/de rjes mthu ldan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dam tshig phog pa'i dge bsnyen 'khor bcas kun/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bsam don sgrub pa'i phyir/ /ring na gnas kyang myur du tshur byon la/ /brtse gdung byams pa'i thugs kyis nyer dgongs nas/ /rin chen thod snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ /ka ra shing tog sha khrag gtor ma sogs/ /za ba'i dngos po bcud ldan ri ltar spungs/ /rgya ja chang dang khrag zhag mtsho ltar skyil/ /tsan+dan dkar dmar ga bur gur gum dang / /spos dkar sogs kyi dud sprin nam mkha' khyab/ /khrab rmog gzhib dang mda' mdung ral gri sogs/ /sra brtan rno ngar ldan pa'i go mtshon tshogs/ /gsar dngul mu tig mu men byu ru dang / /margad pad rag la sogs rin chen tshogs/ /gos dang dar zab bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / /rin chen bdun dang bum bzang dpag bsam shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang yid bzhin rin po che/ /seṅge stag gzig la sogs spyan gzan tshogs/ /rta glang khyi lug ri dwags mang po dang / /ne tso khu byug la sogs 'dabs chags tshogs/ /srog chags kun kyang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /mdor na srung ma 'khor bcas mnyes byed pa'i/ /mchod sprin khams gsum khyab par sprul pa 'di/ /dge bsnyen chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /kun kyang tshim zhing rab tu dges gyur nas/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis 'grogs mdzod la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen thams cad las/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod/ /zhes brjod cing / de nas mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas/ sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod cing srung ma 'khor bcas thugs mnyes bzhin pa'i ngang nas rang gnas su byon par bsam la/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /zhes sogs kyi dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar thun du bcad nyams su blangs pas/ rmi lam du/

mi dkar po chen pos 'dud pa sogs rang la dge bsnyen 'go ba'i rtags mi 'gyur ba yid ches byung na/ de nas sgrub cing dgra la sbad pa'i tshul ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs su lcags snod du dmar gtor zur gsum pa che ba gcig la chung ba gsum gyi bskor ba la/ sha dmar gyi rgyan dang / rgyas par na thod snam sgyu rlon sogs kyis brgyan pa/ gong gi dkar gtor gyi logs su bshams pa'i mtha' skor du/ khrab rmog gri sogs drag po'i spyan gzigs tshogs tshad bshams la/ gtor ma zhi drag gnyis ka chab kyis dren nas/ rang nyid stan la 'dug ste/ gur mgon sogs kyi bdag bskyed rgyas par bsgom/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum nas brtsams te/ tshigs bcad kyi 'phrin las 'chol ba'i bar gong du bkod pa bzhin nyams su blangs la/ 'on kyang dmigs pa lhag por bya dgos ni/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs su gzhan dkyus bzhin la/ dmar gtor de nyid ā las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag las grub pa'i gtor ma ri dang rgya mtsho lta bur gyur par bsam la/ 'bul ba'i tshe/ gtor ma zhi drag gnyis ka lhan cig tu phul bas/ dge bsnyen 'khor bcas rab tu dges nas/ rang gi gang bgo ba'i 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrubs par khas blangs par bsam pa ni mi 'dra ba'i khyad par tsam mo/ /tshigs bcad kyi 'phrin las bcol grub mtshams/ rang bdag bskyed kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang shin du brtan pa dang bcas pas/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med du shes pa'i ngang nas/ badz+ra sa du sa ma ya srog tri du ma ra ṇa dzaḥ srog thug thug ma ra ṇa dzaḥ srog rbud rbud ma ra ṇa dzaḥ sha la du khrag la du ma la shog dzaḥ zhes sgrub pa'i sngags 'di brgya stong la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzla zhing / de'i bar gyi yid kyi bsam bya ni/ dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams dmar gtor sogs drag po'i mthun rdzas 'di rnams bzhes la/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang / khyad par rnal 'byor pa rang la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad lo zla ma 'gyang par tshar bcad nas gtad rlag tu thong bar mdzod cig snyam pa'i yid kyis drag po'i 'phrin las 'chol dung dung pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa yun ring du byas la/ 'phro 'jog pa na rnga brdung sogs dang bcas/ gson gcig dge bsnyen chen po mthu bo che/ /khyod ni sngon tshe 'phags yul ma ga ta'i/ /rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por gyur pa'i tshe/ /lho phyogs ri sul dben par bsam gtan bsgom/ /de tshe ra rgod sha khrag la chags pas/ /tshe 'phos nas ni gnod sbyin mthu ldan gyur/ /dus der gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yis/ /zhal bstan byin rlabs bstan pa'i srung mar bskos/ /de rjes slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /slar yang spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dge bsnyen chen po mi mngon dbyings nas bzhengs/ /sku la dar nag khams gsum dbang du bsdud/ /g.yas kyi rdo rjes gdug pa rdul du rlog /g.yon pas dam nyams dgra bo'i tsit+ta 'dzin/ /seṅge rtsal chen khams gsum zil gyis gnon/ /lcags spyang 'dur rgyug dgra bo'i bla 'khyams sgrol/ /btsan 'khor gsum brgya dgra la jag pa 'gyed/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir dam rdzas 'di gsol la/ /bdag gi bcol pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod la rol mo drag tu bya zhing gong gi dkar gtor sa gtsang sar bskyal zhing / dmar gtor dam can gyis gsol ba'i lhag ma de/ dug mtsho'i me dpung du gyur pa phyogs su 'phangs pas/ dgra bo'i rnam shes mar me lta bu thum gyis bsad par bsam zhing / deng dus mnyam par dge bsnyen chen pos dgra yul du dmag drangs te/ bsad spyad kyi las mdzad de/ dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bsam mo/

/de nas mtheb srin gyi se gol sngags dang bcas pas gtor mgron gyi bsrung ma gshegs gsol dang / dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis rgyas par bya ba rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /zhes dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje legs pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba dang bcas te bsnyen sgrub bya ba'i tshul gyi lag len don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / slob dpon rin po che'i dngos slob rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang tshan nam mkha'i thog che mda' ltar 'phen par mdzad pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug lang 'gro dkon mchog gi gdung rigs 'dzin pa'i 'gro'i sngags 'chang rigs 'dzin 'jigs bral dang / 'gro'i dge slong bstan pa'i rdo rje gnyis kyi nyams len/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mgyog par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa bkra shis don grub bo/ 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyis bsam don thams cad 'bad med du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //skabs 'dir yi ge pa nor bu bkra shis kyis bgyis pas/ 7dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /rgyal khams yongs kyi chos spyod rab 'phel zhing / /bstan 'gro rnams la bde skyid 'phel ba dang / /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 a myes zhabs/ dam can rdo rje legs pa'i bskul bzhugs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
